name: Anthony Towns
cooked: I wonder if that indicates the foundry blocks were invalid somehow – too many transactions, bad transaction ordering, an invalid transaction in a mempool, or bad math in the coinbase somewhere? That would cause block relay to fail very quickly. As an FPPS pool, presumably individual miners didn’t see an impact.
